changelog: 🔬 Phase 24: REA Reverse Engineering Suite, Multi-Agent Codex & OpenCode Bridge.
🛠️ Reverse Engineering Anything (REA): JADX decompiler, APKTool resources, Hermes bytecode recovery, Rizin disassembler, and GDB debugger integration via on-demand tool supervisor.
🤖 OpenAI Codex Protocol Integration: High-performance pure Rust bridge daemon handlers (/api/codex/*) supporting JSON-RPC methods, request approvals, turn metadata, and WebSocket event replays.
🌐 OpenCode Multi-Provider Gateway: Pure Rust handlers (/api/opencode/*) with custom provider CRUD, endpoint model probing, OAuth callbacks, MCP supervisor, and SSE relay.
📱 Android Development Suite: Jetpack Compose, Kotlin, Flutter, and React Native phone-based build and tooling supervisor.
⚡ 100% Rust-First Native Architecture: Zero Go dependencies for new modules, fully validated with unit tests across all native layers.
